source.label: A Git repository
source.explain: Copies one branch of a repository into a new project. Nothing is started. For a private repository, save a login below first.
source.name: Project name
panel.title: Git source
panel.dirty: Files were edited by hand here: an update would be refused.
logins.title: Logins for private repositories
logins.explain: Save an access token (read-only is enough) for a Git host. It is stored encrypted, never shown again, and sent only to repositories of exactly that host.
panel.checkTip: Asks the remote whether the branch has new commits
panel.updateTip: Replaces the project's files with the latest commit. Nothing is redeployed.
panel.updateDeployTip: Updates the files, then runs docker compose up -d
panel.forgetTip: Stops following the repository. The files stay as they are.
panel.forgetConfirm: Stop following the Git repository? The project's files stay, but Armadok will no longer update them.
logins.forgetConfirm: Forget the saved login for {{host}}? Private repositories there can no longer be updated.
